boards.title:
DISCOVERY &
BACKLOG CREATION
boards.goal: Define the VED workflow, users, data requirements and prioritized product backlog.
activities: Review the project requirements and separate Admin and Designer responsibilities.
Organize the upload, AI review, canonical geometry, routing, costing and report workflow into small tickets.
Define acceptance criteria for immutable originals, shared geometry, authorization and historical prices.
boards.milestone: Prioritized VED product backlog with ticket dependencies, scope boundaries and documented acceptance criteria.
acceptance: Stakeholder sign-off is not inferred from documentation.

boards.title:
PROTOTYPING &
ARCHITECTURE
boards.goal: Model the user journey and the shared data contracts before feature integration.
activities: Map authentication, projects, uploads, proposal review and saved 2D/3D workspaces.
Define the ERD, FastAPI service boundaries, candidate schema and versioned canonical geometry.
Review workspace layouts and feedback paths with the intended Designer and Admin users.
boards.milestone: System architecture, database diagrams, geometry contracts and workspace designs ready for implementation and review.
acceptance: Formal client design approval remains a separate event.

boards.title:
FOUNDATIONAL
ENGINEERING
boards.goal: Establish secure identity, database persistence, source safety and durable processing controls.
activities: Implement React/Vite and FastAPI with configurable MySQL connectivity and OAuth/OIDC access.
Build owner-scoped projects, floors and validated JPEG/PNG/PDF uploads with unchanged originals.
Persist processing jobs, source pages, artifacts, review authority and concurrent layout saves.
Complete the PRE0-PRE12 readiness checks before model work.
boards.milestone: Working platform foundations with durable records, preserved originals and a recorded PRE12 readiness gate.
acceptance: Historical PRE12 foundation gate is PASS.
This gate does not establish a production AI release.

boards.title:
AI & ELECTRICAL
PLANNING INTEGRATION
boards.goal: Connect reviewable floor-plan proposals to synchronized geometry, routing and backend estimates.
activities: Prepare source views and validate wall, symbol and observed-wiring proposals with explicit provenance.
Support Designer corrections and shared versioned geometry for Konva 2D and Three/R3F 3D.
Integrate obstacle-aware A*, service-level routes, vertical drops and explicit multi-floor connectors.
Use database materials and prices for draft BOMs and captured-price estimate snapshots.
boards.milestone: Integrated development workflow from upload and review through saved layouts, electrical routes and versioned estimates.
acceptance: Integration is implemented in the development tree.
Independent accuracy and measured real-input costing remain unproven.

boards.title:
QUALITY ASSURANCE &
OPTIMIZATION
boards.goal: Make the current editing, source-evidence and costing changes reproducible and reviewable.
activities: Capture the dirty-tree baseline; run full backend/frontend, build and lint gates; resolve catalog lint debt.
Integrate endpoint magnets, draft BOM pricing and source-backed evidence as scoped changes.
Verify native 2D/3D dragging, exact anchors, cancel/disconnect, undo/redo and save/reload.
Check pricing units, historical snapshots, stale routes and reanalysis durability; align status documentation.
boards.milestone: Reviewed integration changes and recorded regression, live interaction, pricing and source-preservation evidence.
acceptance: SP-01 through SP-10 have explicit dependencies and completion checks.
All required selected-scope gates must pass; failures are not silently skipped.

boards.title:
REPORTING, GO-LIVE &
EVALUATION
boards.goal: Complete reporting, audit traceability and evidence-based acceptance of the full VED workflow.
activities: Implement Q1-Q4: version-linked PDF contracts, generation, protected retrieval and report history UI.
Implement R1-R3: safe workflow audit events and an Admin-only audit viewer.
Prepare deployment and a complete login-to-report acceptance walkthrough with approved real inputs.
Close independent gold evaluation, model/runtime selection and signed U14 promotion/rollback gates.
boards.milestone: Stored PDF reports, safe audit history, validated MVP acceptance and documented deployment/release evidence.
boards.timeline:
After stabilization gate
Dates: to be confirmed
acceptance: Report totals retain the captured estimate version after price changes.
Human, independent-data and release evidence remain required.

cards.title: Freeze report data contract
cards.body: Bind project, layout, routes, BOM and costs to one stored estimate version.
cards.done: Contract excludes live-price recalculation.

cards.title: Generate planning PDF
cards.body: Render quantities, captured unit prices, totals, date and prepared-by identity.
cards.done: Readable PDF stored outside originals.

cards.title: Persist and serve reports
cards.body: Create report records and protected generation/download endpoints.
cards.done: Old report downloads retain old costs.

cards.title: Build report workspace
cards.body: Show report status, errors, version history and PDF download.
cards.done: Designer can generate and reopen a report.

cards.title: Capture a clean baseline
cards.body: Inventory the current dirty tree. Record full backend/frontend, build and lint results.
cards.done: Reproducible baseline; existing work preserved.

cards.title: Resolve catalog lint debt
cards.body: Decide how to retain, fix or exclude the unused DeviceMeshCatalog source.
cards.done: Full lint passes without masking errors.

cards.title: Align status documentation
cards.body: Reconcile README counts, implementation status and the chronological progress ledger.
cards.done: Current API/schema inventory is recorded.

cards.title: Close the integration gate
cards.body: Run full regression, build and lint after the scoped integration changes.
cards.done: Gates pass; failures remain visible.

cards.title: Integrate endpoint magnets
cards.body: Shared 2D/3D connection controls exist locally; prepare a focused reviewable change.
cards.done: Exact anchors, cancel and disconnect persist.

cards.title: Integrate draft BOM pricing
cards.body: Review the local BOM, workbook import, separate pricing and CSV changes as a bounded slice.
cards.done: Draft totals stay distinct from snapshots.

cards.title: Integrate source-evidence fixes
cards.body: Source-backed helpers are checkpointed; worker/detector integration remains local.
cards.done: Existing raw results and reviews survive.

cards.title: Verify native 2D / 3D drag
cards.body: Reproduce actual pointer acquisition, connection, cancellation and reload in both views.
cards.done: Recorded live drag succeeds in both views.

cards.title: Verify pricing and units
cards.body: Exercise known-answer draft/snapshot totals, roll conversions and stale-route refusal.
cards.done: Exact decimals; historical prices stay fixed.

cards.title: Verify reanalysis durability
cards.body: Check reviewed overrides, endpoint attachments and unchanged originals through reanalysis.
cards.done: No lost corrections or fabricated paths.

cards.title: Independent detection evidence
cards.body: U3/U5/S3 need approved gold projects and thresholds; independent 85% accuracy is unproven.
cards.done: Frozen independent evaluation is approved.

cards.title: Real measured costing
cards.body: Latest live BOM evidence lacks active prices, exact-page scale and reusable purchase inputs.
cards.done: Admin prices + Designer measures validate BOM.

cards.title: Production model release
cards.body: Runtime/model selection, approved training and signed U14 promotion are separate gates.
cards.done: Sealed evaluation and rollback evidence pass.

cards.title: Identity, upload and jobs
cards.body: OAuth/OIDC roles, original preservation, durable jobs and PRE0-PRE12 foundations exist.
cards.done: Historical readiness evidence is recorded.

cards.title: Shared 2D / 3D geometry
cards.body: Versioned canonical snapshots feed Konva and Three/R3F with conditional saves.
cards.done: Metric acceptance remains input-dependent.

cards.title: Saved electrical routing
cards.body: Obstacle-aware A*, service-level paths, drops/risers and route version persistence exist.
cards.done: Engineering and real-input QA stay separate.

cards.title: Versioned estimates
cards.body: Catalog/history, quantities and captured-price estimate APIs/UI are implemented.
cards.done: Reports and real costing QA remain open.

detailed_acceptance: Run existing backend, frontend, build and lint gates; preserve the dirty tree and private artifacts.
Resolve six reported catalog lint errors; do not silently add missing libraries or suppress checks.
Native drag + click/keyboard paths; exact coordinates, cancel/disconnect, undo/redo and save/reload.
Known quantities x captured prices; draft vs snapshot semantics; conversions; missing and stale inputs.
No lost reviewed paths or attachments after reanalysis; source checksums and history remain intact.
Re-measure counts and reconcile stale README claims with actual code and recent checkpoints.
Reports reference stored estimate/layout/route versions; unchanged historical totals; authenticated access.
Safe audit fields and role enforcement; no secrets or raw provider credentials in recorded details.
Independent gold, thresholds, rights, training authority and signed release; synthetic tests do not close these.

sources.finding: Shared canonical geometry; server-authoritative prices; preserve originals; one ticket at a time.
Q1-Q4 define PDF reporting; R1-R3 define audit logging; S3-S6 define quality and calculation gates.
Latest October 12: endpoint magnets are local uncommitted work; native drag is inconclusive; 83 files / 684 frontend tests reported.
Historical PRE12 foundation gate passed on September 6; this is not a production AI release.
Real-data approval, independent evaluation, model selection, training and release remain distinct gates.
Estimate/material routes are registered; no report or audit router is registered.
Versioned estimate endpoints and draft/historical BOM CSV endpoints exist.
Draft BOM UI, material/price/unit controls, paper dimensions and CSV export are present.
Shared endpoint connection logic exists in the current local work.
Untracked catalog imports @react-three/drei; ledger records six lint errors. Adoption/removal needs an explicit decision.
